    edges = case['edges']
    refinement = case['refinement']
    # Build community membership
    members = {}
    for node, community in refinement.items():
        members.setdefault(community, []).append(node)
    # Sort each membership list
    for comm in members:
        members[comm].sort()
    # Build aggregated edges
    agg = {}
    for src, tgt, w in edges:
        cs = refinement[src]
        ct = refinement[tgt]
        # Canonicalize undirected pair
        c1, c2 = (cs, ct) if cs <= ct else (ct, cs)
        key = (c1, c2)
        agg[key] = agg.get(key, 0) + w
    # Convert to list and sort
    aggregate_edges = []
    for (c1, c2), total in agg.items():
        aggregate_edges.append([c1, c2, total])
    aggregate_edges.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
    return {'aggregate_edges': aggregate_edges, 'members': members}"
}
